title: This guy built a $30k MRR app in one day with Claude Code. Here's the tools he uses.
description:
Built a full app in one day with Claude Code.

Jack runs Profit.ai, a Shopify profit analytics app that’s done $147K since launch in December and is at $30K MRR (plus ~$40K in services).

He’s not technical. He built the original version by dumping a spreadsheet into Cursor as a CSV and iterating.

Here’s what he runs the business on now:

Claude Code on the $200/mo max plan for building
Codex in Terminal (not the app) for extra coding muscle
Framer for the marketing site (may swap to a Claude-built site)
Instantly for outbound marketing
Google Sheets for the ops layer
Slack + Claude bot to pipe data wherever clients need it
